rules.readout_name_exact: Mean Ribosome Load (MRL) / Top-2.5% GFP Bin Enrichment
rules.statement: Out-of-frame upstream AUG (uAUG) in the 5'UTR strongly reduces translation (GSE232927 N=25000: rho=-0.5821, 95% CI [-0.5945, -0.5754]; Cao2021 GSE176581 Top-2.5% MPRA rho=None, Endogenous TE rho=None).

audit_history.reason: Direct Colab empirical verification on strictly commercial-clean public GEO/CC-BY-4.0 datasets (deduplicated by underlying_dataset_id).

rules.statement: Purine (A/G) at position -3 relative to canonical AUG boosts 5'UTR translation initiation (GSE232927 N=25000: rho=0.2178, p=4.344e-266, 95% CI [0.206, 0.2327]; Cao2021 GSE176581 Top-2.5% rho=0.0028).

audit_history.reason: Verified on GSE232927 paired HEK293T MRL; kept conditional pending m1Psi CC-BY-4.0 replication.

rules.readout_name_exact: mRNA Stability Slope (decay_rate in Wu 2019 eLife 45396)
rules.statement: Higher human CDS GC3 and CAI correlate with greater endogenous mRNA stability across HEK293T (CAI rho=0.1042, N=13079, p=6.763e-33) and K562 SLAM-seq (GC3 rho=0.1346, N=8789, p=8.211e-37). Caveat: endogenous spliced mRNAs; do not blindly extrapolate magnitude to intronless m1Psi IVT mRNA without wet-lab calibration.

audit_history.reason: Verified on Wu 2019 CC-BY-4.0 mapped to GENCODE v49 across HEK293T and K562; single underlying study so capped at conditional_rule.

rules.readout_name_exact: mRNA Stability Slope (decay_rate in Wu 2019 eLife 45396)
rules.statement: AU-rich element (ARE, AUUUA) count in the 3'UTR strongly reduces endogenous human mRNA stability (Wu 2019 eLife 45396 + GENCODE v49, N=13079: rho=-0.1911, p=8.078e-108, 95% CI [-0.2055, -0.1734]).

audit_history.reason: Verified on Wu 2019 CC-BY-4.0 + GENCODE v49; supports CellExpressionController 3'UTR ARE avoidance.

rules.readout_name_exact: In-solution hydrolysis half-life (hours) vs In-cell half-life
rules.statement: Lower average unpaired probability (AUP) strongly increases in-solution mRNA hydrolysis half-life (Leppek 2022 GSE173083 Table S5 N=24: rho=-0.7165, p=8.196e-05), BUT in-solution half-life does NOT positively predict in-cell half-life (Table S1 N=191: rho=-0.1243, p=0.08663). Optimization must treat in-solution stability and in-cell expression as separate Pareto objectives.

audit_history.reason: Verified on Leppek 2022 CC-BY-4.0 PERSIST-seq; explicitly captures in-solution vs in-cell decoupling.

rules.statement: Substituting m1Psi (mpU) for unmodified U across 39 identical synonymous eGFP CDS variants shifts median reactivity lower (mpU=0.3324 vs U=0.3572; mpU vs 5moU Wilcoxon p=1.454e-07) and breaks construct-level rank concordance (Spearman mpU vs U = -0.0686, N=39 paired constructs; per-nt structRFM probe trained on U drops from 0.5918 to 0.5124 when tested zero-shot on m1Psi). Unmodified-U structure rankings must NOT be extrapolated directly to m1Psi therapeutic constructs without chemistry-specific parameters or probes.

audit_history.reason: Directly measured across all 117 Mauger 2019 Moderna CC-BY-4.0 SHAPE-MaP files (39 paired constructs x 3 chemistries).

rules.readout_name_exact: Mean Ribosome Load (MRL) / Top-2.5% GFP Bin Enrichment / Endogenous TE
rules.statement: High GC content in the 15 nt immediately upstream of the canonical AUG start codon (gc_tail15) consistently reduces translation across TWO independent strictly commercial-clean labs: Castillo-Hair 2024 GSE232927 (N=25,000, rho=-0.0550, p=3.15e-18) AND Cao 2021 MIT GSE176581 after 5'/3' adapter stripping (Top-2.5% MPRA N=4,000 rho=-0.0482, p=2.28e-3; Endogenous TE N=4,000 rho=-0.0986, p=4.15e-10).

audit_history.reason: Independent concordant negative direction confirmed across two distinct labs and underlying datasets (GSE232927 + GSE176581).
